if [ -f /etc/default/aide ]; then
    . /etc/default/aide
fi

# Defaults
MAILTO="${MAILTO:-root}"
CONFIG="${CONFIG:-/etc/aide/aide.conf}"

# Options
opt_f=0
opt_y=0
opt_c=0
opt_b=0

if ! [ -f "/usr/bin/aide" ] && ! [ -f "/usr/sbin/aide" ]; then
  printf >&2 "no /usr/bin/aide found, check your dependencies\\n"
  exit 1
fi

aideinit_usage() {
    printf >&2 "Usage: %s [options] -- [aide options]\\n" "$0"
    printf >&2 "  -y|--yes         Overwrite output file\\n"
    printf >&2 "  -f|--force       Force overwrite of database\\n"
    printf >&2 "  -c|--config      Specify alternate config file\\n"
    printf >&2 "  -o|--output      Specify alternate output file\\n"
    printf >&2 "  -d|--database    Specify alternate database file\\n"
    printf >&2 "  -b|--background  Run in the background\\n"
}

while [ -n "$1" ]; do
    case "$1" in
        -h|--help)
            aideinit_usage
            exit 0
            ;;
        -f|--force)
            opt_f=1
            shift
            ;;
        -y|--yes)
            opt_y=1
            shift
            ;;
        -b|--background)
            opt_b=1
            shift
            ;;
        -o|--output)
            shift
            [ -z "$1" ] && aideinit_usage && exit 1
            outfile=$1

command:
cat > /root/ansible/etc-integrity-baseline.yml <<'PBEOF'
---
- name: Establish AIDE integrity baseline for /etc
  hosts: targets
  become: false
  gather_facts: true

  tasks:
    - name: Update apt cache
      apt:
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600

    - name: Install AIDE and distribution config helpers
      apt:
        name:
          - aide
          - aide-common
        state: present

    - name: Check whether an AIDE baseline database already exists
      stat:
        path: /var/lib/aide/aide.db
      register: aide_db

    - name: Initialize the AIDE database (builds the /etc baseline, among other watched paths)
      command: aideinit -y -f
      when: not aide_db.stat.exists
      register: aideinit_result

    - name: Re-check baseline database file after init
      stat:
        path: /var/lib/aide/aide.db
      register: aide_db_after

    - name: Fail if the baseline database was not created
      fail:
        msg: "AIDE baseline database /var/lib/aide/aide.db was not created"
      when: not aide_db_after.stat.exists

    - name: Confirm /etc is covered by the AIDE ruleset
      command: grep -q '^/etc\$ d VarDir' /etc/aide/aide.conf.d/70_aide_etc
      changed_when: false

    - name: Run an AIDE check against the new baseline to confirm it is usable
      command: aide --check --config=/etc/aide/aide.conf
      register: aide_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: aide_check.rc not in [0, 1]

    - name: Show AIDE check summary
      debug:
        var: aide_check.stdout_lines
